newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen weak on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen weak on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are in for a choppy ride on Tuesday as individuals and speculators square positions on the last clearing day, dealers said.

"Sentiment will remain from mixed to down as there is little support from genuine investors because of the country's weak economic fundamentals," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "But select buying is expected on Wednesday, the new accounts day."
On Monday, the Karachi 100-share index fell 15.18 points, or 0.95 percent, to 1,575.65. Losers led gainers 189 to 73.
Turnover rose to 41 million shares from 27 million in the previous session. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
